page.overview:
Who is Ben Daheer?

Ben Daheer is a minor fictional character in Skyfall.

Ben Daheer is one of the five undercover MI6 agents whose cover was blown by Silva after he shared them on a YouTube video. M told to Bill Tanner to get them out but three was executed in another video. The fate of the other two is unknown. He presumably dead.
